instruction: Export the current video frame as an image named 'video_snapshot.png' to the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.verification: Task requires taking a VLC screenshot and saving to video_snapshot.png. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Desktop/video_snapshot.png.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator performs comprehensive validation beyond simple file existence
Getter extracts complete file metadata: existence, file type, size, PNG validation, magic bytes
Metric validates file is a valid PNG image using both file type string and magic bytes (89504e47)
Metric checks minimum file size (1024 bytes) to prevent empty or trivial files from passing
Complete coverage: can distinguish between valid PNG screenshots and fake/invalid files
Logic is robust and practical: uses standard Unix commands (test, file, stat, xxd)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts right state, metric performs comprehensive comparison
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add maximum size check to detect unreasonably large files (though not critical)
Minor: Could validate image dimensions are reasonable for a video screenshot (though PNG validation is usually sufficient)
